paths.@guardrail/contracts: Import @guardrail/contracts/errors. The barrel re-exports envelope.ts and signing.ts, which import node:crypto, so a value import from it pulls node:crypto into the browser bundle.

paths.@guardrail/db: The gateway does not talk to a database. Ask the owning service over the bus.

paths.@guardrail/auth/server: Only apps/web/src/app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts may import this. The Better Auth instance carries a database client, and the gateway is not allowed one. Everywhere else asks identify() for a normalised identity.

paths.@guardrail/guardrail: Client code reads plan and permission state from useViewer(), or calls the API through useTRPC().
paths.@guardrail/billing: Client code reads entitlements from useViewer().
